Sokolow Malopolski Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Sokołów Małopolski, Poland

Not demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'demolished and overbuilt,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' This is the older of Sokołów Małopolski's two Jewish cemeteries, established around the mid-17th century; tzadikim were buried there until the 1870s. It was destroyed during WWII and leveled; after 1960, the Communal Cooperative built warehouses on the site, one of which still functions as a building-materials store today. In 1995, at the initiative of the Jewish Landsmanshaft from Canada, a new ohel for the tzadikim was added.
